name: gpu-launch-week-throttler-aggressive
description: Halve demand-throttler interval (60 -> 30) and shorten its cooldown (120 -> 60) so it reacts faster to GPU-fault-storm and dashboard-storm pressure. Bumps the no-dropped-refreshes objective weight to its max (1.0) to prioritize keeping the executive dashboard fresh during pressure windows. Example policy artifact for PR 13's policy-search runner. Does NOT change scene topology, demand, pressure, or objectives -- only agent heuristics, per the SL1 spec contract.
